about: Tells a store's customers whether an item is in stock.
case: One WhatsApp chat with one customer; the case id is the chat id.

actions.reply: One answer to a customer message, checked before it goes out.

replied.about: The reply passed the send check and went out.

no_safe_reply.about: No reply passed the send check, so nothing went out.

answered.about: The customer got a clear stock answer.

high.about: High risk: any number, any promise of a date, and a customer's personal data.
